description.zh: 基于 Meshy API 的 AI 小物件 3D 低模资产生成：文/图/多图 → lowpoly mesh → (可选 refine PBR 纹理) → (可选 remesh 降面) → glb → 落盘游戏可用资产。区别于 wb-3d-lowpoly（程序化 CAD）。
description.en: Meshy-API-driven AI generator for small 3D lowpoly props: text/image/multi-image → lowpoly mesh → (optional refine PBR) → (optional remesh) → glb → durable game asset. Distinct from wb-3d-lowpoly (programmatic CAD).

description.zh: 读取 Meshy 凭证/余额 + COS 配置状态；返回静态、无配额数据。
description.en: Read Meshy credential/balance + COS config state. Static, no quota.

description.zh: 文生低模（Meshy text-to-3d, model_type:lowpoly, mode:preview）→ 落盘持久 manifest。未配置 Meshy 时回退确定性 mock。
description.en: Text-to-lowpoly (Meshy text-to-3d, model_type:lowpoly, mode:preview) → durable manifest. Mock fallback when Meshy unconfigured.

description.zh: 图生低模（单图, model_type:lowpoly, 需 COS 中转）→ 落盘持久 manifest。
description.en: Image-to-lowpoly (single image, model_type:lowpoly, COS relay) → durable manifest.

description.zh: 多视角生低模（多图, model_type:lowpoly, 需 COS 中转）→ 落盘持久 manifest。
description.en: Multi-image-to-lowpoly (multi-view, model_type:lowpoly, COS relay) → durable manifest.

description.zh: 给 preview 低模加 PBR 纹理（Meshy text-to-3d mode:refine）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Add PBR texture to a preview lowpoly (Meshy text-to-3d mode:refine) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 给已有模型换风格 PBR 纹理（Meshy retexture）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Restyle an existing model with PBR texture (Meshy retexture) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 对已有 Meshy 任务结果重拓扑降面到 target polycount（Meshy remesh）→ 新持久 manifest。
description.en: Remesh an existing Meshy task result to target polycount (Meshy remesh) → new durable manifest.

description.zh: 本地图片上传 COS（中转产物,非资产）→ 24h presigned URL 供 Meshy URL-fetch。未配置 COS 报 cos_not_configured。
description.en: Upload local image to COS (transfer artifact, NOT an asset) → 24h presigned URL for Meshy URL-fetch. Errors cos_not_configured if COS unset.

description.zh: 列出当前游戏已生成的 props 3D 资产 manifest。
description.en: List the active game's generated props 3D asset manifests.

description.zh: 读取 Meshy + COS 凭证掩码配置状态（不返回明文）。
description.en: Read masked Meshy + COS credential config state (no plaintext).

description.zh: 写入/更新 Meshy key + COS 凭证 + 总开关到插件本地 .env 并即时生效。
description.en: Write/update Meshy key + COS credentials + master switch to plugin-local .env, applied live.
